title: Standardized work sheet - front door assembly station
text: Standardized work sheet for the front door assembly station. Takt time is 58 seconds. The operator installs the door hinge bolts, torques them with the nutrunner and checks the gap with the gauge before the vehicle moves to the next process.

title: Just-in-time production schedule for the Tacoma line
text: Just-in-time production schedule for the assembly line. The heijunka box levels the mix of models across the shift so the line produces cabs, beds and frames in small batches according to customer demand.

title: Paint shop process sequence
text: Process sequence for the paint shop. Bodies go through pretreatment, electrocoat, sealer application, primer, base coat and clear coat booths, then enter the curing oven. Each booth has a standardized cycle time and line speed.

title: Kaizen event - welding cell changeover
text: Kaizen event on the welding cell. The team applied SMED to reduce die changeover time on the stamping press and robot welding fixtures from 22 minutes to 9 minutes, increasing line uptime and production output.

title: Andon response procedure on the assembly line
text: Andon response procedure. When an operator pulls the andon cord the team leader arrives within the fixed position stop, solves the abnormality and restarts the line. Jidoka stops production so no defect flows downstream.

title: Stamping press operating instructions
text: Operating instructions for the transfer stamping press. Load the steel coil, verify die alignment, run the first piece check and record tonnage. Production of side panels and hoods follows the scheduled lot sizes.

title: Total productive maintenance plan for robots
text: Total productive maintenance plan for welding robots and conveyors. Operators perform daily autonomous maintenance, cleaning and lubrication. Planned maintenance prevents breakdowns that stop the production line.

title: Final assembly line balancing study
text: Line balancing study for final assembly. Work elements were redistributed among stations so every process fits within takt time, reducing operator waiting and overburden while keeping the production rate.

title: Paint defect root cause analysis
text: Quality report on paint defects. Inspectors found dirt inclusions and orange peel on hoods. The 5 Whys root cause analysis traced the defect to a clogged filter in the booth. Countermeasure: filter replacement schedule.

title: Final vehicle inspection checklist
text: Final inspection checklist. Inspectors verify panel gaps, paint finish, electrical functions, water leak test and road test before the vehicle is released. Any nonconformity is recorded and sent to repair.

title: Customer warranty claims analysis Q3
text: Warranty claims analysis for the third quarter. Most claims relate to infotainment software and brake noise. Pareto chart shows the top five defects represent 70 percent of warranty cost. Quality engineering opened corrective actions.

title: Supplier part nonconformity report
text: Nonconformity report for a supplier part. Incoming inspection rejected a lot of headlamp housings due to cracks. The supplier must submit an 8D corrective action report and containment of suspect stock.

title: Statistical process control for torque
text: Statistical process control for wheel nut torque. Control charts show the process is stable and capable with Cpk above 1.33. Out of control points trigger an investigation and quality hold.

title: Recall investigation - fuel pump
text: Recall investigation summary. A defect in the fuel pump impeller may cause engine stall. Quality and engineering defined the affected vehicle range, the inspection method and the replacement procedure for dealers.

title: Quality audit of the body shop
text: Internal quality audit of the body shop. Auditors checked weld spot quality, dimensional accuracy with the coordinate measuring machine and documentation of inspection results. Two minor findings were reported.

title: Poka-yoke error proofing review
text: Review of poka-yoke error proofing devices. Sensors detect missing clips and wrong part variants so defects are caught at the source. Quality circle proposed three new error proofing devices.

title: Occupational safety policy
text: Occupational safety policy. Every team member has the right and the duty to stop work if conditions are unsafe. Personal protective equipment such as safety glasses, gloves and steel toe shoes is mandatory on the plant floor.

title: Lockout tagout procedure
text: Lockout tagout procedure for maintenance on energized equipment. Isolate electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic energy, apply personal locks and tags, and verify zero energy before entering the robot cell.

title: Near miss incident report - forklift
text: Near miss incident report. A forklift nearly struck a pedestrian at a blind intersection in the warehouse. Countermeasures include mirrors, marked pedestrian walkways and reduced forklift speed limits.

title: Ergonomics risk assessment
text: Ergonomics risk assessment for overhead work under the vehicle. Operators showed shoulder strain risk. Recommended lift assist devices and job rotation to prevent injuries and musculoskeletal disorders.

title: Chemical handling and spill response
text: Chemical handling procedure for paint solvents. Store flammable liquids in approved cabinets, read the safety data sheet and use respirators. Spill response requires absorbent kits and evacuation if vapors are present.

title: Emergency evacuation plan
text: Emergency evacuation plan for fire and earthquake. Alarm signals, evacuation routes, assembly points and roles of floor wardens are defined. Drills are performed twice a year in every building.

title: Monthly safety performance report
text: Monthly safety report. The plant recorded zero lost time injuries and four first aid cases. Safety walks identified housekeeping issues and unguarded pinch points that were corrected.

title: Hazard identification for battery handling
text: Hazard identification for high voltage hybrid battery handling. Workers must wear insulated gloves, use insulated tools and confirm the service plug is removed to avoid electric shock.

title: Hybrid powertrain efficiency test
text: Research report on hybrid powertrain efficiency. Engineers tested the new power control unit on the dynamometer and measured fuel economy and electric motor efficiency under different driving cycles.

title: Brake system test specification
text: Technical specification for brake system validation. Prototype vehicles undergo fade tests, wet braking and stopping distance measurements. Design engineers compare results against the target specification.

title: Solid state battery prototype evaluation
text: Evaluation of solid state battery cell prototypes. Researchers measured energy density, charging time and cycle life. Results guide the design of the next generation battery electric vehicle platform.

title: Crash simulation of new chassis
text: Crash simulation study using finite element analysis on the new chassis design. The engineering team optimized the frame structure to improve occupant protection in frontal and side impact tests.

title: Hydrogen fuel cell stack durability
text: Durability study of the hydrogen fuel cell stack. Engineers ran accelerated aging experiments and analyzed membrane degradation to extend stack life for fuel cell electric vehicles.

title: Aerodynamics wind tunnel report
text: Wind tunnel test report. Engineers measured the drag coefficient of the prototype design and tested modifications to the front bumper and underbody panels to reduce aerodynamic drag.

title: Driver assistance sensor fusion design
text: Design document for advanced driver assistance. The software architecture fuses camera and radar data for lane keeping and pre-collision braking. Engineers validated the algorithm in simulation and test tracks.

title: Lightweight materials research
text: Research on lightweight materials. Engineers compared high strength steel, aluminum and carbon fiber for body panels, evaluating weight reduction, cost and manufacturability for future vehicle designs.

title: Kanban replenishment procedure
text: Kanban replenishment procedure. When a parts bin is emptied at the line the kanban card returns to the supplier, triggering delivery of the exact quantity. Inventory levels stay low and parts arrive just in time.

title: Supplier delivery performance report
text: Supplier delivery performance report. On time delivery reached 98.5 percent. Two suppliers missed delivery windows due to transport delays and must submit recovery plans to logistics.

title: Milk run logistics route plan
text: Milk run logistics plan. A truck follows a fixed route collecting parts from several local suppliers at scheduled times, reducing transport cost and inventory while synchronizing deliveries with production.

title: Supplier code of conduct
text: Supplier code of conduct. Suppliers must comply with labor laws, environmental regulations and anti corruption rules. Purchasing evaluates suppliers on quality, cost, delivery and sustainability.

title: Semiconductor shortage risk plan
text: Supply risk plan for semiconductor chips. Purchasing mapped tier two and tier three suppliers, increased safety stock of critical chips and qualified alternative sources to protect production.

title: Inbound parts warehouse layout
text: Warehouse layout for inbound parts. Receiving docks, sequencing area and line side storage are arranged to minimize forklift travel. Logistics uses the warehouse management system to track inventory.

title: Customs import procedure for parts
text: Customs procedure for imported parts. Logistics prepares the commercial invoice, packing list and import documents. Brokers clear shipments at the border so parts reach the plant on schedule.

title: Supplier capacity planning review
text: Capacity planning review with suppliers. Purchasing shared the production forecast and suppliers confirmed capacity for next year volumes. Bottlenecks were found at the seat supplier.

title: New operator onboarding program
text: Onboarding program for new team members. During the first week employees learn Toyota Way values, respect for people, plant rules and complete basic skills training in the training center before joining the line.

title: Andon cord training module
text: Training module on the andon system. Trainees learn when and how to pull the andon cord, practice in a simulated line and pass a skills assessment. The trainer records the certification in the employee file.

title: Team leader development curriculum
text: Curriculum for team leader development. Courses cover job instruction, problem solving, coaching and leadership. Participants complete an A3 project mentored by their group leader.

title: Skills matrix for the assembly group
text: Skills matrix for the assembly group. The matrix shows which employees are certified in each process and plans cross training so the team can cover absences and job rotation.

title: Performance review and career policy
text: Performance review policy. Employees and managers set yearly goals, hold a mid year feedback meeting and a final evaluation. Results inform promotions, career development and compensation.

title: Job instruction training method
text: Job instruction training method for trainers. Break down the job into important steps and key points, demonstrate, let the learner practice and follow up until the employee performs the task correctly.

title: Knowledge transfer from retiring experts
text: Program for knowledge transfer from retiring senior technicians. Experts mentor apprentices, record video lessons and write know-how sheets so tacit knowledge stays with the company.

title: Employee suggestion system guidelines
text: Guidelines for the employee creative idea suggestion system. Team members submit improvement ideas, supervisors review them and employees receive recognition and rewards for implemented suggestions.
